submitted.rationale: With 3 merit measurements, I tested one point near the middle of the library (V-rich, #52: 0.28 µA) and two Fe-rich points. The Fe-rich region gave about 7× more photocurrent. #13 (Cr0.21 Fe0.59 V0.21) measured 2.01 µA, slightly more than #200 (Fe0.70, V0.11) at 1.75 µA. This suggests the best composition has moderate V (~0.2) in an Fe-rich oxide.

rejected.reason: Measured 0.28 µA; the V-rich middle of the library performs poorly.
Measured 1.75 µA, below #13; lowering V further to 0.11 reduced photocurrent.
Not measured. Cr oxides absorb weakly and have poor PEC activity, and the Fe-rich trend pointed away from them.
